note: The product is a general-purpose, open-source portable SDLC starter for unrelated codebases. Maintainer tests using external projects, vendor-specific native hosts or protected state are not adopter installation prerequisites. The release does not bundle or automatically control any private host.
excluded_claims: native third-party host/session actions without explicit adapter support
writes to existing unrelated governed projects without their owners' authorization
independently verified delivery of external effects or provider responses
concurrent deletion in roots with uncontrolled writers
host-specific automation beyond the portable SDK and its tests
